# ai studio

> ai studio is an international architecture, design and urbanism practice based in London and Moscow. The studio works on contemporary architecture grounded in context — across master planning, public and private buildings, interiors and research.

## Studio

- [Studio](https://aistudio.co.uk/studio): About the practice, philosophy, team, and offices in London and Moscow.

## Work

- [Works](https://aistudio.co.uk/works): Portfolio of architecture, urbanism, interiors and design projects.
- [Journal](https://aistudio.co.uk/journal): Long-form writing, essays and research from the studio.
- [News](https://aistudio.co.uk/news): Announcements, project milestones and studio updates.
- [Press](https://aistudio.co.uk/press): Selected media coverage and publications featuring the studio.

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://aistudio.co.uk/privacy-policy): How the site handles personal data.
- [Cookie Policy](https://aistudio.co.uk/cookie-policy): Use of cookies and tracking technologies.
